policies.name: users create own suggestions
policies.check: ((submitted_by = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'submitted'::suggestion_status) AND (reviewer_id IS NULL) AND (merged_product_id IS NULL) AND (created_product_id IS NULL))

triggers.name: product_suggestion_convert_held_listing
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER product_suggestion_convert_held_listing AFTER UPDATE OF status, created_product_id ON product_suggestions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION convert_approved_missing_listing()

triggers.name: trg_product_suggestions_touch
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_product_suggestions_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON product_suggestions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()
